Cache simulator

Direct mapped, 2-way set associative and fully associative, on the same address stream.

Main memory

Each block holds four consecutive bytes and is copied into one cache line when fetched. Shaded blocks are in the selected cache. Click any byte to request it.

A 64-byte memory, 4-byte blocks and a 4-line cache. Pick an organisation, choose an address and access it. Every access is applied to all three caches at once, letting you switch tabs to compare how each one handles the same pattern.
